'''2025 Naboo Regionals John Moorley DS rots vader''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Moorley]] at [[2025 Regional Championships]] (Naboo).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[John Moorley]]
* '''Event:''' [[2025 Regional Championships]]
* '''Stage:''' Naboo
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Revenge Of The Sith|V17-D-revengeofthesith.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:25Naboo Moorley DS ROTS Vader.txt |Download]]
